name: optimus
description: Optimus — the operating brain and lead loop for an authorized AT&T fiber dealership in Houston, Beaumont and Brazoria County. One plugin, two skills: optimus-brain (context) and gold-cluster-sweep (the work).

metadata.description: Installing this once keeps Cowork, claude.ai and Claude Code on the same brain. optimus-brain is generated from CLAUDE.md by scripts/build_brain_skill.py, so the plugin and the repo brain cannot drift apart.

plugins.name: optimus
plugins.description: The Optimus operating brain and the full lead loop. optimus-brain carries the dot legend and what each colour pays, the sheet and GoHighLevel IDs, which tabs the hunter owns, and the texting, DealMachine and data-integrity facts that cost real time to learn. gold-cluster-sweep runs the loop: dig the backlog first, find a dense gold pocket, pull the green, gold and small businesses on those streets, skip-trace for cells, text/email/dial, book the visit, follow up.
